attributes.additional_details:
Make it easier for the public to understand what MPs do.
Expand the Register of Members' Interests to include all corporate interests and potential conflicts of interest.

Use AI to organise existing parliamentary data into simple, factual summaries and statistics.

Create an easy-to-use public search tool.

Improve transparency, accountability and public trust at low cost by using existing public data.
attributes.background: I want the Government to increase transparency by expanding the Register of Members' Interests to include all corporate interests, and by using AI to track MPs' work, provide factual statistics, and make their parliamentary activity easier for the public to search and understand.

rejection.details:
We are not clear about the action sought by this petition. 

Members are already required to declare potential conflicts of interests, so we are not sure how what you are calling for would be different to what is already happening. 

We were not sure about the action sought in relation to the public search tool, for example what data would be presented or how this would be different to the already available information on the parliamentary website.
